title: Chapter 174
text:
Han Xiao looked at the other item.

LV30 Special Dungeon Crystal: [Olena Infiltration Plan]

Introduction: Olena is Ordina's secret research facility. A few years ago, Dean bypassed the security and stole Ordina's military secrets. This will be your test.

Dungeon Type: Time Reversal Dungeon

Current Number of Players Cleared: 0

Fastest Time Cleared: 00: 00: 00

Record Holder: None

Only those who entered the dungeon would know the mission of the dungeon. Han Xiao guessed that the mission was to enter Dean's perspective and steal the secrets repeatedly.

The Dungeon Crystal was risky, so Han Xiao decided not to use it. He stored it in the interface and might be able to sell it to the players in the future.

…

Three days later, at the designated meeting point in a small valley in the wilderness, two of Dean's masked subordinates were waiting. Han Xiao paid and received the goods on the spot. The process went smoothly.

After returning to the transport plane, Han Xiao opened the metal box that he had just received. It was filled with the materials he had just bought.

U9 Colloidal Bulletproof Film. Its function had already been explained.

"Vein" Biological Transmission Wire. It increased energy efficiency and power output. It could be used to slightly increase the basic attributes of the mech.

Rapid Injection Module. It could be used as a built-in mech to inject some medicine, such as healing potions, hormones, and so on. Han Xiao also bought some painkillers.

With all the materials, Han Xiao had learned enough blueprints. He decided to go into seclusion to create his own mech.

In order not to be distracted, Han Xiao parked the plane at a secret location and suspended all other activities.

…

Five days later, Han Xiao rubbed the dark circles under his eyes. Looking at the finished product on the workbench, he revealed a relieved and relaxed smile.

"It's done."

Successful. You have created your own blueprint!

Please name the blueprint …

Han Xiao muttered to himself. This lightweight mech was an imitation of the Viper mech. Many of the modules and functions were different from the original. He had changed a lot of things and thought of a suitable name.

Naming successful. You have received the blueprint [Lightweight Mech — Viper — Modified].

"That's a good name." Han Xiao was satisfied.

Viper's modified appearance was a pure black combat suit. The chest, abdominal muscles, thighs, and back were embedded with a thin layer of silver-gray platinum alloy as the outer layer of armor. Below the neck, in the center of the back, there was a circular space in the armor where a small bonfire reactor was embedded. It shone with a faint red light, and the gaps of the armor were filled with a thin layer of U9 colloidal bulletproof membrane. Its defensive capabilities were extremely high.

The inner lining of the combat suit was filled with PE-0 fibers, woven into muscle lines to increase strength. From the transparent bulletproof membrane, one could see that the lines of the black combat suit were similar to human muscles.

The helmet was an integrated visor, and the mouth part was similar to a black metal mask. The material was breathable, and it was equipped with an air filter device. From the user's perspective, it was a tactical goggles and a panoramic analysis screen. All sorts of scanning data were listed on it, and the changes in the surrounding environment and the battlefield were clear at a glance.

There were also various small weapon modules installed on the Mech.

[Viper – Modified]

Type: Battle Uniformed Light Mech

Rarity: White

Basic Attributes: 5,600/5,600 Armor, 137 Defense, 578 Power Level, 2,600/2,600 Energy

Height: 1.82m

Weight: 108lb

Control Method: Human Body Control + Low-Level Smart Chip

Energy Source: Small Bonfire Reactor – Auto-recharge, restores 20 Energy Points per minute. If Energy is used as fuel, Energy Consumption: 10/s, Energy Recovery: 6/s

Standby Mode Consumption: 12 Energy/min

Battle Mode Consumption: 28 Energy/min

Core Power Output: 421/600

Skeleton Module: PE-0 Nano Synthetic Fiber, Biochemical Tendon Inner Skeleton, Muscle Strength can be strengthened according to the user's movements. Muscles harden when under attack, increasing physical performance. + 38 STR, + 25 DEX, + 12 Defense Power Output

Armor Module: Platinum Alloy Plate, + 1,800 Armor, + 30 Defense, None Power Output

Armor Module: U9 Colloidal Bulletproof Membrane, + 2,400 Armor, + 45 Defense, None Power Output

Outer Layer Module: Optical Camouflage, Able to refract light to a certain extent. Power Output: 20

Eye Module: Electromagnetic Scanning, Thermal Imaging, and Night Vision in one. Internal Tactical Holographic Observation Screen, Power Output: 25

Right Palm Module: Thermal Incisor Gauntlet, Inflicts high temperature damage over time. Energy Consumption: 1.2/s, OP Output: 94, Power Output: 50

Left Palm Module: Thermal Incisor Gauntlet, as above

Right Wrist Module: Sunworm Small Flamethrower, Energy Consumption: 1/s, OP Output: 98, Power Output: 45

Left Wrist Module: Repulsive Field Driver (Guided Type), Releases repulsive waves in a 150-degree direction. Range: 20 meters. Cooldown: 30 seconds. Each use: 10 Energy Consumption: 60

Leg Module: Electromagnetic Powered Hovering Boots, Energy Consumption: 5/min, Power Output: 30

System Module: Body Condition Monitor, Power Output: 5

System Module: Smart Fire Control System, Assist in Aiming and Shooting, Power Output: 5

System Module: Target Analysis Database, Power Output: 5

Accessory Module: Rapid Injection Needle, Equipped with Painkiller, Power Output: 10

Accessory Module: Small Spider Detector x8, None Power Output

Accessory Module: Electromagnetic Pulse Controller, Grants [Excited] status, + 5% to all Attributes for 15 minutes. Each use: 5 Energy Consumption: 10

Accessory Module: SUI Anti-Radar Coating, None Power Output

Accessory Module: Small Radar, Power Output: 18

Accessory Module: Air Filtration Device, Comes with Oxygen Storage Function, Can be independently supplied for 15 minutes, Power Output: 8

Accessory Module: Thermostat Device, Power Output: 10

Additional Ability: Strong Performance – Distributes energy to the Biochemical Tendons in Battle Mode, generating more power. + 40 STR, + 20 DEX

Additional Ability: High Toughness – Uses Platinum Alloy and U9 Colloidal Bulletproof Film, Corrosion Resistance, High Temperature Resistance

Remark: A successful replica.

He could see the detailed information of the various modules by clicking on them, and he knew them all.

"Finally, the mechanical suit is done." Han Xiao was excited. He had almost 200,000 experience points.

Viper Modification mainly increased the individual strength of the soldiers. It was equipped with small weapon modules, such as the Thermal Incisor Gauntlet, Sunworm, Repulsive Field, and so on. The power output was not full yet, but there would be more suitable modules in the future.

Viper Modification increased Han Xiao's combat power to a whole new level, and it did not hinder him from using all kinds of guns, grenades, and other weapons. This mechanical suit was the second set of battle tactics. It provided more protection and increased his overall attributes. If he activated Battle Mode, the increase in strength would be even greater than his own attributes.

He had the sniper style for long-range attacks and the mechanical suit for close-range attacks. Viper Modification was very light and could be folded into a metal box to carry around. When he was not wearing the mechanical suit, he had the magnetic armor to protect himself.

"I need to test my actual combat power." Han Xiao decided on his next destination. He was going directly to the site of the Tragedy of Robert Potter.

Killing that beast boss was also part of his plan.

…

The site of the Tragedy of Robert Potter was now a forbidden area occupied by wild beasts. The mutated virus had strengthened the wild beasts in this area. This virus was called the Death Virus.

On the barren brown land, a group of mutated rhinoceroses galloped past. They were huge, had bulging muscles, and hideous bone spikes like armor. The cone-shaped horns on their heads shone with a metallic luster.

In the sky, a giant python with four pairs of bat wings flew across the sky and pounced on a corpse. On the ground beside the corpse, a blue flower swaying in the wind suddenly expanded into an abyss-like mouth. It swallowed the giant python in one gulp and then resumed its harmless disguise.

"The wild beasts here have all mutated."

At the edge of the forbidden area, Yang Dian and Ned observed the situation with binoculars. They were two solo superheroes who had received a request to enter the forbidden area to search for a trapped civilian exploration team. This civilian exploration team was in danger because they were investigating the source of the virus. In the eyes of the two, they were very noble and accepted their employer's request without hesitation.

"Originally, there was slight radiation in the Robert Potter area. This is also the reason for the mutation of the Death Virus," Ned said.

"According to the map of the exploration team before they went missing, they went missing in a valley, some distance away from us."

"There are many unknown dangers in there. We have to be careful."
